chat.title: Chat Model Not Configured
chat.desc: Click the button above to open Settings and add the API key for your Summary & Chat model. The plugin needs it before it can summarize, analyze comments, answer questions, or build mind maps.

asr.title: Speech-to-Text Not Configured
asr.desc: This video has no captions. Click the button above to open Settings and add an ASR API key. The plugin will then transcribe the audio for you.

options.title: Configuration

sections.aiModelDesc: Used for video summaries, comment analysis, Ask AI, and mind-map generation. Pick a provider and supply your own API key.
sections.asrDesc: Used for videos without official subtitles. Digital audio is extracted and sent to this API for transcription.

placeholders.notionParentPageId: Share the page with your integration, then paste its 32-char ID

options.languageHint: Affects sidebar / popup / options UI, and the language the AI answers in.
options.storageNote: All keys are stored locally in your browser.

freeHint.usage: Once created, select the matching model in the dropdown above and paste the API Key into the input field.
freeHint.help: Unfamiliar with the sign-up or key creation steps? Ask any AI chatbot to walk you through it.
freeHint.chatIntro: If you don't have any paid AI model API Key yet, we recommend signing up for Ollama. You can register an API Key for free, and free users get a generous quota that's plenty for non-heavy usage.
freeHint.asrIntro: If you don't have any paid AI model API Key yet, we recommend signing up for Groq. You can register an API Key for free, and free users get a generous quota that's plenty for non-heavy usage.
